leastWorthwhile.text: Clipping and mounting the pen were straightforward assembly steps, but less informative than the tests.

surprise.text: The first straight-ahead test produced a curve because one motor was faster; the trim adjustment corrected the control rather than the drawing.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; each part had a clear role in building or testing the rover.

continue.text: Yes. The practical test and adjustment were worth the time, and I would be curious to see what the fair does with the inventions next.
